actualLocalChecks.fixtureScope: Mocked refusal, authentication-destination, archive and partial-outcome controls; no publication performed.
Synthetic payload/provenance/signature-identity/runtime-receipt/environment refusal controls; no application executed.

actualLocalChecks.method: Independently read the retained original GitHub artifact ZIP; verified archive size and digest, exact selected file set, fixed source, all manifest package versions and all twelve nupkg SHA-256 values against release.json.

exclusions: No NuGet key or OIDC credential was read, generated or used by this reviewer.
No package was pushed or unlisted and no permissions, publisher scopes, secrets or account settings were changed by this reviewer.
No dotnet public restore, business application, Native AOT build or public runtime matrix was executed in this review.
The source review and 27 synthetic/local tests do not establish public release completion or a new migration-runtime acceptance.
This record is an independent technical review by a separate agent, not another GitHub account approval.
pendingExecutionGates: Actual existing NUGET_PUBLISH_ENABLED value observed by PR preflight; a false or absent switch must fail and cannot be reported as publication.
Normal product PR required checks, normal merge and applicable main CI.
Successful existing trusted-publisher exchange, actual package uploads or exact existing-payload readback, official signing and listing confirmation for all twelve versions.
Actual public-source SQLite/PostgreSQL times JIT/Native AOT execution and all native/closure/provenance checks.
Actual HelloWorld authorization result and final unlisted state for every version, independently recorded even if database publication succeeds.

resolvedFindings.finding: Publisher signature logs were written to signatures/ while upload-artifact initially selected signature-logs/.

reviewedControls: Successful push-to-main CI attempt, repository ID, source commit/tree, artifact ID/name/size/digest and all twelve original package archives are fixed before promotion; candidate provenance remains unchanged.
All existing package versions are downloaded and verified before the first new upload. A 409 is accepted only after exact unsigned-entry comparison and real repository-signature verification.

NuGet PUT is restricted to its fixed endpoint and DELETE to the authorized HelloWorld identity. Credential-bearing redirects are refused. GitHub artifact storage redirects are allowlisted and receive no GitHub authorization header.

Publication API keys and GitHub/OIDC/runtime credentials are removed from signature subprocess scope; public consumer child processes also remove publication and runner tokens. Receipts retain only safe allowlisted metadata and public verification logs.

Repository-signature certificates are obtained from the official NuGet service resource. Cryptographic verification must succeed, then the actual repository-primary route, service index, exact dekueon owner set, certificate SHA-256 and subject must match.

Upload and unlist journals distinguish started/unconfirmed, accepted-awaiting-readback, authorization rejection and confirmed final state. Database publication and HelloWorld retirement keep separate outcomes.
All HelloWorld flat-container versions must match the registration inventory; final listed=false is required for every version, and newly observed unattempted versions prevent completion.
The public consumer uses the exact accepted Program.cs, fresh external projects and empty private caches, only the official public NuGet source, no source ProjectReference and no candidate feed.

Public consumption verifies the exact provider dependency closures and every package payload/signature, then runs SQLite/PostgreSQL times JIT/Native AOT. AOT requires actual Linux x64 ELF output, dynamic-code=false and an execution witness; both modes verify the actually mapped native-library hash and deterministic owner retirement.

The original publication-enable variable remains required. PR preflight explicitly checks its non-secret value. Only the exact repository main push/dispatch can enter the nuget environment and request an OIDC token.

The workflow retains raw publisher signatures and consumer logs, requires successful publication, four-cell consumption and retirement outcomes, and preserves the old build/acceptance workflow unchanged.
Documentation preserves the distinction between accepted local candidates and completed public delivery and does not consolidate package IDs or alter the accepted native binaries.

reviewer.authorship: The reviewer authored none of the ten reviewed product files. The reviewer authored this record, earlier migration closeout review records and read-only upstream scope/action research.

upstreamAuthorizationConclusion.conclusion: Trusted Publishing credential construction copies the matched policy scopes; package:push does not imply package:unlist. The actual policy scopes have not been read. A normal authorized attempt must record the real result, including a possible 403, without altering scopes or account permissions.
upstreamAuthorizationConclusion.scopeEvidenceNote: The fixed upstream CredentialBuilder clones the matched policy scopes; the scope extension matches the exact allowed action or All; ApiController DeletePackage requires PackageUnlist and the scope filter rejects unauthorized requests. This makes no assumption about the live account policy.

verdict.scope: The reviewed implementation may proceed to normal PR checks and the existing authorized publisher workflow. Real registry mutation, signed readback, public consumers and final retirement are separate pending execution gates.
